==Description==
'''Couldron''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Halloween 2020 Event#Halloween Season Pass|Halloween Season]]. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote.

This emote was obtainable at Rank 10 of the Event Season Pass, which would cost 650 Candies or {{Robux|200}} at that rank. The total cost was 4,485 Candies or {{Robux|1,130}}.

==Trivia==
*This [[Emotes|emote]] is misspelled, as the correct spelling is ''Cauldron'', not ''Couldron''.
*The cauldron emits purple smoke, and produces purple bubbles and sparkles.
*In the cauldron are four small humanoids. They are all faceless and have their own unique torso color.
*The cauldron used in this emote can collide with objects and parts. However, it cannot collide with players.
**Using the '''Couldron''' emote next to a thin wall, while facing it, will clip the cauldron through it.
